about.subtitle: Jonathan Bélisle & the Paracosm Spiral
about.intro_p1: For over 25 years, Jonathan Bélisle has explored the boundaries between storytelling, experience design, and living technology. His journey begins in 1997, on the margins of experimental cinema and the nascent Internet. Early on, he co-founded Inconet and StratSite, where he became one of the first web solution architects in Quebec. At this time, he understood that every system, even digital, is a story in potential.
about.intro_p2: From 2004 to 2010, he acted as UX strategist and information architect for agencies like Sid Lee, VDL2, Loft8, BlueSponge and Phéromone. He implemented human-centered practices there, focusing on meaning and depth of experience. These were years of cultural transformation of the agencies themselves, where he acted as an 'organizational storyteller'.
about.intro_p3: In parallel, he founded Hello, Architekt!, a studio dedicated to prospective storytelling, accompanying creative mutations and pedagogy through design. He accompanies cities, museums, schools and companies to reconfigure their identity through embodied narratives. It was at this time that he imagined the Wuxia the Fox project: a series of interactive books that merge poetry, voice, and technology. The project was awarded, translated into several languages, and deployed in more than 1,500 schools.
about.intro_p4: From 2012 to 2017, Jonathan taught interaction design at INIS, co-founded the UXMTL community, directed the Emergence Lab at the Banff Centre and collaborated with the Canadian Museum for Human Rights. He became a mentoring figure in Franco-Canadian creative ecosystems.
about.intro_p5: In 2017, he co-founded Ensemble Ensemble, a collective of public and critical technology art. They notably created The Compassion Machine, a provocative installation that predicts your future acts of kindness. Between 2019 and 2021, he became DesignOps Director at Behaviour Interactive, then consultant in speculative storytelling at The Greenhouse @ Deloitte, where he guides leaders and strategists in mapping futures.
about.intro_p6: Since 2021, he has been acting as Head of Design at Prodago, where he shapes ethical artificial intelligence governance systems that are sensitive to human experience.
about.intro_p7: Today, he founded Paracosm — a living laboratory where speculative storytelling, somatic coaching, poetic ontologies, AI agents and prototyping retreats converge. This is also where Calm Magic was born, a school of leadership based on the body, breath and meaning.
about.conclusion: Paracosm is a spiral. An interior and collective map to traverse uncertainty with grace. It's not a site. It's a field of living intelligence. You are invited to enter.

case_studies.subtitle: Discover our transformation journeys and innovation projects

oaciq_elise.title: Élise - OACIQ Virtual Assistant
oaciq_elise.subtitle: Conversational robot for Quebec real estate brokerage
oaciq_elise.description: Development of an intelligent conversational assistant to accompany real estate brokers and the public in their procedures. Élise answers questions about regulations, buying/selling processes, and guides users to the right OACIQ resources.
oaciq_elise.role: UX designer and conversational experience developer, applying the Calm Magic methodology to create a benevolent and professional interaction.
oaciq_elise.results: 24/7 accessible virtual assistant capable of answering complex regulatory questions, guiding brokers and consumers, and simplifying access to OACIQ services.
oaciq_elise.impact: Significant improvement in accessibility to real estate information for professionals and the public. Reduced waiting time to get answers to common questions.

wuxia_the_fox.title: Wuxia the Fox
wuxia_the_fox.subtitle: Interactive Children's Book & AR Platform
wuxia_the_fox.description: Transmedia educational project launched in Quebec, co-produced with SAGA and public broadcaster TFO. The work takes the form of an illustrated tale associated with an interactive iPad application, combining traditional mythology and modern technologies.
wuxia_the_fox.role: Creator and director of the project, developing augmented narration that mobilizes oral reading and voice recognition.
wuxia_the_fox.results: A 200-page illustrated book with physical modules (masks, wooden blocks to scan) and an iPad app in augmented reality. The device camera recognizes images and symbols from the book to trigger complementary audiovisual animations.
wuxia_the_fox.impact: Funded via successful Kickstarter campaign and published in French and English. Won special mention at Grand Prix Numix 2015 for innovation.

io_theatre.title: Io Theatre
io_theatre.subtitle: Intelligent Stage Space Prototype
io_theatre.description: Prototype of intelligent scenic space funded by the Canada Media Fund, allowing synchronization of narrative content with sensors and physical objects in real time.
io_theatre.role: Creative director and developer of the first 'Experience Design Management System' platform.
io_theatre.results: Users become directors of their wandering, with set elements and media reacting to their presence.
io_theatre.impact: First platform for real-time narrative experience management, laying groundwork for future spatial installations.

simulateur_genial.title: Simulateur Génial!
simulateur_genial.subtitle: Interactive Science Installation
simulateur_genial.description: Playful installation at the Musée de la civilisation in Quebec City, recreating the universe of the scientific television show Génial! in a museum context.
simulateur_genial.role: Interactive designer and technical director for IoT implementation.
simulateur_genial.results: Young participants trigger spectacular natural phenomena using connected objects, reproducing the show's experiments.
simulateur_genial.impact: Won Prix Gémeaux 2016 (best derivative digital production) for its ingenuity. Increased youth engagement at the museum.

awards.0: Prix Gémeaux 2016 - Best Derivative Digital Production

naissance_du_monde.title: La Naissance du monde
naissance_du_monde.subtitle: Interactive Oral Storytelling
naissance_du_monde.description: Interactive tale presented as part of Loto-Québec events. The public was invited to read aloud a physical grimoire to trigger, through voice, a projected animation telling an Amerindian creation legend.
naissance_du_monde.role: Creator and director, adapting voice recognition for offline and noisy environments.
naissance_du_monde.results: Thousands of participants engaged in summer events at Old Port, Lafontaine Park, etc.
naissance_du_monde.impact: Won Grand Prix Créa 2016 (online advertising category) and Prix Boomerang 2015 for interactive experience.

lachine_passages.title: Lachine Passages
lachine_passages.subtitle: Urban Narrative Experience
lachine_passages.description: Experimental route in Montreal's Innovation Quarter, combining urban design and interactive storytelling. Installations along the Lachine Canal projected local stories when visitors lingered.
lachine_passages.role: Creative advisor for integrating narrative dimension into urban development.
lachine_passages.results: Audio stations and motion sensors triggering sound stories as visitors pass, creating poetic link between industrial past and technological future.
lachine_passages.impact: Pilot experience mixing urbanism and storytelling, serving as showcase for Innovation Quarter.

machine_bienveillance.title: La Machine à bienveillance
machine_bienveillance.subtitle: Interactive Public Art Installation
machine_bienveillance.description: Interactive public art piece deployed in Montreal (Saint-Laurent station) as part of KM³ for the city's 375th anniversary. A giant futuristic camera that measures the 'disposition to kindness' of passersby.
machine_bienveillance.role: Co-designer (UX scriptwriter and interactive director) with Ensemble Ensemble collective.
machine_bienveillance.results: Large eye-catching urban art installation that scans volunteers and displays a real-time collective kindness index.
machine_bienveillance.impact: Successful subversion of surveillance technology for celebrating altruism, creating social reflection on empathy and trust.

banff_residence.title: Banff Emergence Lab
banff_residence.subtitle: Creative Direction & Innovation Residency
banff_residence.description: Director of the first edition of the Banff Emergence Lab, a Franco-Canadian interactive writing laboratory bringing together traditional authors and digital professionals.
banff_residence.role: Expedition director, orchestrating intensive workshop reuniting Canadian and European creators.
banff_residence.results: Several innovative concepts born (interactive web-series sketches, hybrid installations) and lasting network between creators.
banff_residence.impact: Created sustainable bridge between traditional and digital creators, spreading new interactive writing practices internationally.

tedx_montreal.title: TEDx Montréal
tedx_montreal.subtitle: Transmedia Reading: Let's read with all 5 senses!
tedx_montreal.description: TEDx talk addressing multisensory transmedia reading, demonstrating how reading with voice, gestures and all senses can reinvent the children's book experience.
tedx_montreal.role: Keynote speaker, demonstrating Wuxia technology and vision for conscious technology use.
tedx_montreal.results: Influential talk sensitizing public to dangers of passive technology and proposing creative, conscious screen use in family rituals.
tedx_montreal.impact: Significant impact raising awareness about digital addiction in children and promoting active, creative technology use.

sxsw_talk.title: SXSW Interactive
sxsw_talk.subtitle: Storytelling Engines for Smart Environments
sxsw_talk.description: Conference panel at South by Southwest where Jonathan presented his vision of narrative engines for connected environments, discussing how IoT can awaken the 'relational poetry' of the physical world.
sxsw_talk.role: Panelist and thought leader on smart cities and narrative computing.
sxsw_talk.results: Reinforced Jonathan's international reputation in creative smart cities domain.
sxsw_talk.impact: Positioned physical world as narrative platform, influencing discourse on human-centered smart environments.

calm_magic_methodology.title: Calm Magic Methodology
calm_magic_methodology.subtitle: Technopoetic Design Framework
calm_magic_methodology.description: Original conceptual framework developed by Jonathan Bélisle to fuse poetry, experience design, and systems thinking in projects. A 'technopoetic' approach aimed at creating transformational digital experiences.
calm_magic_methodology.role: Creator and evangelist of the methodology, applying it across all Paracosm projects.
calm_magic_methodology.results: Comprehensive methodology implemented across all major projects, distinguishing Paracosm's approach in the interactive media landscape.
calm_magic_methodology.impact: Influenced design thinking in Quebec's creative technology sector, providing framework for human-centered innovation.
